crossRefs.note: and because he didn’t need for anyone to testify concerning man; for he himself knew what was in man.
He said to him the third time, “Simon, son of Jonah, do you have affection for me?” Peter was grieved because he asked…
A certain woman named Lydia, a seller of purple, of the city of Thyatira, one who worshiped God, heard us. The Lord…
When she and her household were baptized, she begged us, saying, “If you have judged me to be faithful to the Lord…
When they had come in, they went up into the upper room where they were staying; that is Peter, John, James, Andrew…
There were many lights in the upper room where we were gathered together.

parallels.note: He will himself show you a large upper room furnished and ready. Get ready for us there.”

translations.web: He will show you a large, furnished upper room. Make preparations there.”
translations.bsb: And he will show you a large upper room, already furnished. Make preparations there.”
translations.kjv: And he shall shew you a large upper room furnished: there make ready.
translations.asv: And he will show you a large upper room furnished: there make ready.
